scope_note: Primary research and official author-publication abstract only. Search-index text remains stored_search_excerpt even when long. No external LLM API. Mechanisms are generic cards without organism engineering, sequences, protocols or optimization.

evidence.title: Structural insights into sodium transport by the oxaloacetate decarboxylase sodium pump
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: utilizes the free energy derived from oxaloacetate decarboxylation for sodium transport
evidence.limits: 2020 primary structure establishes subunit architecture; elevator-like movement/coupling remains a model, as authors acknowledge in peer review. 1981 purified-protein liposome experiment supplies direct energetic-coupling evidence; no universal stoichiometry claimed.

supplementary.finding: Reconstituted vesicles accumulated sodium using oxaloacetate decarboxylation; sodium ionophores abolished transport while a proton uncoupler did not.
Authors acknowledge that static structure does not establish detailed mechanical coupling.

evidence.title: An allylic ketyl radical intermediate in clostridial amino-acid fermentation
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: a kinetically competent product-related allylic ketyl radical bound to the enzyme
evidence.limits: Primary isotope EPR identifies the product-side allylic ketyl and supports catalysis. Initial ketyl and enoxy stages are proposed. ATP-dependent reductive activation is not claimed to consume ATP every substrate turnover. No organism growth or engineering guidance.

supplementary.finding: Primary activation experiments; introduction/figure 1 explains electron return and substoichiometric reductive activation.

evidence.title: Refining the pathway of carbide insertion into the nitrogenase M-cluster
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: the methyl group is transferred to a precursor-associated sulfur before hydrogen abstraction
evidence.limits: Isotope labeling, acid-quench products and Fe/Se substitution establish sulfur attachment and order of initial steps. Subsequent complete dehydrogenation and cluster-rearrangement sequence remains a model.

supplementary.finding: Primary radiolabel study establishes SAM methyl as carbide carbon source; correct DOI is 10.1126/science.1224603, not the preceding unrelated PDF-page DOI 1224947.

evidence.title: Catalytic mechanism of a retinoid isomerase essential for vertebrate vision
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: ester dissociation occurs by O-alkyl cleavage rather than acyl cleavage
evidence.limits: 2015 primary inhibitor-complex structures plus isotope and stereochemical results support ionization/rotation/water-capture route. Retinyl cation not directly trapped. Do not claim an unbiased free cation alone explains site selectivity.

evidence.title: Stepwise O atom Transfer in Heme-Based Tryptophan Dioxygenase: Role of Substrate Ammonium in Epoxide Ring Opening
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: the O atom transfer takes place step-by-step
evidence.limits: 2018 primary synthetic-probe, NMR and MS experiments identify a monooxygenated furoindoline interpreted as a rearranged unstable epoxide; it is not direct epoxide capture. Substrate-ammonium function is inferred with rate/probe evidence.

supplementary.finding: 2009 primary spectroscopy observes a ferryl intermediate during IDO catalysis; failure to observe it in TDO does not establish its absence.

evidence.title: Isoprenoid Biosynthesis: Ferraoxetane or Allyl Anion Mechanism for IspH Catalysis?
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: supportive of an allyl anion IspH intermediate
evidence.limits: 2013 isotope HYSCORE and DFT support an allyl anion bound to oxidized Fe4S4 rather than a ferraoxetane. This is spectroscopic structural assignment, not atomic-resolution capture of every elementary step. Do not combine IspG as an independently counted variant.

supplementary.finding: Primary ENDOR study proposes organometallic substrate interaction; later isotope HYSCORE provides discrimination of competing models.

evidence.title: Mechanism of O2 Activation and Cysteine Oxidation by the Unusual Mononuclear Cu(I) Active Site of the Formylglycine-Generating Enzyme
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: spectroscopically observed post-HAA intermediate containing the thioaldehyde product coordinated to a Cu(I)–OOH site
evidence.limits: 2025 primary kinetic/spectroscopic/computational study identifies thioaldehyde-containing intermediate and later ligand sulfenate. Earliest Cu-superoxide is short-lived and assigned mechanistically. Hydrolysis to aldehyde is included; not oxygen-rebound hydroxylation.

supplementary.finding: 2019 primary XAS/crystal work identifies direct substrate thiolate binding to Cu(I) before oxygen activation.

evidence.title: Evidence for the formation of a covalent thiosulfinate intermediate with peroxiredoxin in the catalytic mechanism of sulfiredoxin
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: its mass was shown to correspond to a thiosulfinate complex
evidence.limits: Primary yeast enzyme LC-MS and kinetics establish catalytically competent covalent thiosulfinate. Substrate is typical 2-Cys peroxiredoxin sulfinic acid, not generic sulfonate repair.

supplementary.finding: 2008 ATP/Mg structure and phosphorylation of substrate mimics support direct substrate-sulfinate phosphorylation; do not repeat the superseded obligatory phosphorylated-Srx-first scheme.

evidence.title: Structure of a human S-adenosylmethionine decarboxylase self-processing ester intermediate and mechanism of putrescine stimulation of processing as revealed by the H243A mutant
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: The mutant protein is trapped in the ester form
evidence.limits: H243A primary 1.5-A structure directly demonstrates ester intermediate. N-to-O acyl shift alone is shared with inteins; novelty is subsequent beta elimination and conversion of the serine-derived new terminus to pyruvoyl.

supplementary.finding: Primary self-processing structure study summarizes ester beta elimination to dehydroalanine followed by hydrolysis to pyruvoyl and cautions that single mutant conformations can mislead.

evidence.title: Crystallographic capture of a radical S-adenosylmethionine enzyme in the act of modifying tRNA
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: cross-linked to a tRNAGlu substrate through the terminal methylene carbon of a formerly methylcysteinyl residue
evidence.limits: Official author-publication record reproduces the original Science abstract. Mutant covalent crosslink is captured; crosslink resolution is required for turnover. No resistant organism, target engineering, sequence or optimization instructions. RNA species and carbon positions remain one mechanism.

supplementary.finding: Original primary text describes H abstraction from enzyme methylcysteine, radical addition and covalent-link resolution; do not assert every proton/thiol step established.

evidence.title: The HydG enzyme generates an Fe(CO)2(CN) synthon in assembly of the FeFe hydrogenase H-cluster
evidence.limits: Primary stopped-flow IR and isotope ENDOR identify ligand assembly and metal provenance. Later work refines auxiliary iron to a fifth dangler site, so card avoids asserting removal of a cubane-core Fe or direct one-step transfer to mature hydrogenase.

supplementary.finding: 2021 primary QM/MM study treats dehydroglycine radical-relay sequence as a proposal and identifies the Fe(II)(Cys)(CO)2(CN) assembly intermediate in context of prior evidence.

evidence.title: Stepwise Hydride Transfer in a Biological System: Insights into the Reaction Mechanism of the Light-Dependent Protochlorophyllide Oxidoreductase
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: three discrete intermediates were resolved, consistent with a stepwise mechanism
evidence.limits: Primary time-resolved spectroscopy supports electron-first, subsequent proton-coupled electron transfer and protonation. Intermediate electronic identities are assignments; net hydride addition does not imply transfer of a free hydride ion. The substrate chromophore is excited directly.

evidence.title: A tetrameric DNA structure with protonated cytosine.cytosine base pairs
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: two base-paired parallel-stranded duplexes are intimately associated, with their base pairs fully intercalated
evidence.limits: Primary 1993 solution NMR structure at acid pH. Count relies on proton-coupled C:C+ pairing plus intercalated duplex topology, not cytosine substitution alone. No universal physiological folding or regulation claim.

exclusions.reason: Primary evidence exists, but present boundary against elastic torsional phase switching and DNA topology needs more than handedness/geometry; held.
Base extrusion is an access step shared across existing methylation and glycosylase entries. No independently justified input-transformation function yet.
Primary hemithioacetal structures exist, but boundary against proton-transfer tautomerization and thiol-carbonyl chemistry not settled. Held.
Existing photosystem-manganese-water-oxidation-cycle already states charge accumulation and O-O formation. Improved structural resolution is source enrichment.

exclusions.candidate: protein pyruvoyl-catalyzed amino acid decarboxylation variants
exclusions.reason: Do not separately count substrate or electron-sink cofactor variants of decarboxylation. This batch counts only the distinct backbone-elimination cofactor maturation.
No second FGE card based solely on enzyme family or aerobic/anaerobic conditions; anaerobic route not researched enough to demonstrate an independent catalytic sequence.

exclusions.candidate: nitric oxide reductase cis/trans hyponitrite route
exclusions.reason: Competing binding/coupling models and existing broad anoxic-denitrification card require stronger pathway discrimination; held.
Classical proposed peroxynitrite assignment is contested; ferric-nitrate interpretation prevents presenting peroxynitrite as directly observed.
Oxaloacetate, methylmalonyl-CoA and glutaconyl-CoA routes share decarboxylation-energy sodium pumping and remain one mechanism.
Simple sulfur substrate or reductase identity changes do not justify extra rows without a distinct activation sequence.
